What we look for

The places revenue escapes.

Twenty-two checks look for the places revenue escapes: missed-call exposure, booking friction, response-time clarity, lead capture, follow-up, trust proof and service coverage. You get the list, the size of each gap, and what it would take to close it.

A caller who reaches voicemail rings the next name on the list. That is the whole mechanism, and it is why the first fix is always the phone.

How it works

One loop runs the whole thing.

NEVAMIS is not a stack of disconnected tools. It is one loop: observe the business, understand it, find what is costing money, act inside rules you approve, measure what changed, and learn from the result. The phone is one capability inside that loop, not the whole product.

What you can actually buy.

If something is not on this list, it is not for sale. Each automation is its own product with its own price, sold on its own evidence, and joins the front desk one at a time.

  • AI Front Desk. Every call answered, the job captured, the details texted to you.
  • Missed-Call Recovery. A missed call gets a text back inside seconds, before the caller reaches the next name.
  • Quote-Chase Engine. Sent quotes are followed up on a schedule until the customer answers either way.
  • Review Engine. A finished job asks for the review, at the moment the customer is happiest.

Straight answers

Questions owners actually ask.

Will callers know they are talking to a machine?

The moment anyone asks, yes, plainly and without hedging. It does not open the call by announcing itself, any more than a receptionist opens by explaining who employs them.

Can I keep my current phone number?

Yes. Your number stays exactly as it is, and you can switch the forwarding off from your own phone at any time.

How long until it is live?

The build takes days. A standard single-line setup is answering inside the first week.
